description: Checks availability of a cluster name. Cluster names should be globally unique; at least 3 characters and at most 40 characters long; they must only contain lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens; and must not start or end with a hyphen.

operations.description: Checks availability of a cluster name. Cluster names should be globally unique; at least 3 characters and at most 40 characters long; they must only contain lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens; and must not start or end with a hyphen.

schema.description: Request from client to check cluster name availability.
schema.name: nameAvailabilityRequest

params.description: The ID of the target subscription. The value must be an UUID.
params.name: subscriptionId

consts.description: The API version to use for this operation.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: Indicates whether the cluster name is available.
props.name: nameAvailable

responses.description: Error response describing why the operation failed.
